vulnerability.name: RUSTSEC-2025-0141
vulnerability.description: bincode 2.0.1 — maintainer team ceased development due to doxxing/harassment incident; not a security defect

statements.impact_statement: RUSTSEC-2025-0141 is an unmaintained-status advisory, not a CVE. bincode is pulled transitively via `foca` (SWIM membership protocol) with the `bincode-codec` feature. bincode 2.0.1 has no known vulnerabilities; the advisory exists because the team stopped publishing new versions after a harassment incident. No active exploitation path. Springtale's threat model aligns with the maintainers'; we will not penalize a project whose team faced doxxing.
statements.action_statement: Tracking foca's evolution. Will swap `bincode-codec` for `postcard` or `wincode` when foca publishes an alternative codec feature. No fix needed until then; bincode 2.0.1 is functionally complete per upstream announcement.
